description: This file defines an abstract Endpoint class within a REST API framework for the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for request handling, validation, sorting, and pagination, and serves as a base class for more specific API endpoints.

classes.name: Endpoint
classes.description: An abstract base class for API endpoints providing request initialization, parameter validation, sorting, and pagination functionalities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Endpoint with a Request object, setting up request parameters.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Placeholder method for child classes to implement additional initialization logic.

methods.name: getValidationDecorator
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the ValidationDecorator instance.

methods.name: setSortingAndPaginationParams
methods.description: Sets sorting and pagination parameters on a FilterParams object based on request query parameters, with optional default sort field.

methods.name: getSortingAndPaginationParamsRules
methods.description: Returns validation rules for sorting and pagination parameters.

methods.name: getAttributeId
methods.description: Retrieves the 'id' parameter from request request parameters.
